objective.text: Distinguish a resource response for a recently created model from a normally retrieved model.

difficulty.rationale: Trace the resource response status from model creation state rather than the route’s name.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: No custom response status or withResponse override is applied.

stem: A JsonResource wraps an Eloquent model whose wasRecentlyCreated is true. Another wraps a normally retrieved model with that flag false. What default HTTP statuses do their responses use?

options.text: 200 for both, because resources never infer a creation status.
options.rationale: The default resource response does recognize the recently-created model state.
options.misconception: The default resource response does recognize the recently-created model state.

options.text: 204 for the created model; 304 for the retrieved model.
options.rationale: Those statuses do not follow from the described model state and are not these defaults.
options.misconception: Those statuses do not follow from the described model state and are not these defaults.

options.text: 201 for the newly created model; 200 for the retrieved model.
options.rationale: ResourceResponse checks Eloquent’s wasRecentlyCreated flag when choosing the default status.

options.text: 201 for both, because constructing any resource creates a new response object.
options.rationale: Creating a resource wrapper is not the same as recently creating its underlying model.
options.misconception: Creating a resource wrapper is not the same as recently creating its underlying model.
